title_en: Class Cancellations and Building Closures for 2027 Early Admission Interviews, College of Engineering
summary: Because of the 2027 early admission interviews, all College of Engineering courses are cancelled from 26 November 2026, 09:00, to 27 November 2026, 20:00, and Building 302 is closed in full; it reopens after 8:00 p.m. on 27 November. Courses taught by interview committee members and all courses held in Building 39 are cancelled from 3 December 2026, 09:00, to 4 December 2026, 20:00, and Building 39 is closed in full; it reopens after 8:00 p.m. on 4 December. Make-up classes must be held for every cancelled course, and only examination staff may enter examination rooms in the closed buildings.
applies_to: All students and others in the College of Engineering. First period (General Admission interviews): everyone taking any course offered by the College of Engineering, and everyone who uses Building 302. Second period (Regional Balance and Opportunity Balance Special Admission interviews): everyone taking a course taught by an interview committee member or any course held in Building 39, and everyone who uses Building 39. The building access restrictions are mandatory for everyone except examination staff.

translation:
Class Cancellations and Building Access Restrictions for the 2027 College of Engineering Early Admission (Susi) Interviews

In connection with the interviews (and oral examinations) for the 2027 early admission (Susi) General Admission, Regional Balance Admission and Opportunity Balance Special Admission, classes will be cancelled and access to buildings will be restricted as set out below. We ask for your full cooperation so that the admission process runs smoothly.

A. Class cancellations and access restrictions

General Admission (일반전형), Friday 27 November 2026
- Class cancellation period: Thursday 26 November 2026, 09:00 to Friday 27 November, 20:00
- Courses cancelled: all courses offered by the College of Engineering (make-up classes must be held)
- Access restriction: all of Building 302 (one building)
※ Building 302 may be entered after 8:00 p.m. on Friday 27 November.

Regional Balance Admission (지역균형선발전형) and Opportunity Balance Special Admission (기회균형선발특별전형), Friday 4 December 2026
- Class cancellation period: Thursday 3 December 2026, 09:00 to Friday 4 December, 20:00
- Courses cancelled: courses taught by interview committee members and all courses held in Building 39 (make-up classes must be held)
- Access restriction: all of Building 39 (one building)
※ Building 39 may be entered after 8:00 p.m. on Friday 4 December.

※ During these periods, no one other than examination staff may enter the examination rooms (lecture rooms, professors' offices, seminar rooms, meeting rooms, etc.) located in the restricted buildings.

※ Offices (departments/schools, majors, etc.) operate as normal (staff work normally).
